# CANDIDATE: TRENDLINE_BREAK_CALL_VETO

**Filed:** 2026-09-11

## Hypothesis

The trendline break structure signal, when used as a call veto, avoids call losses on bearish structure days (J's loser days) without affecting put winner trades (J's winner days). This captures the call loser avoidance edge by blocking losing call entries during confirmed bearish structure while leaving put entries unchanged.

## Mechanism

When the 5-minute close breaks through a respected ascending support (indicating bearish structure confirmation via BOS/CHoCH from market_structure.py), we veto any call entry for the remainder of the trading day. Put entries are evaluated independently by the base strategy and are unaffected by this veto. The signal resets at the start of each trading day.
